notes: GEOMETRY from the HOVER report (4 Apr 2025, jobs/summit_point_photos/hover_measurements.pdf), the site photos and Google satellite imagery — the homeowner's plan is drawn mirrored (its left is the yard-facing RIGHT). Facing the house from the yard, left to right: the deck starts at the 2'4" bump with the DirecTV dish (SGD-2), runs 26'11" along the back wall under the tall gable windows (10'6" deep; walkout and covered patio below — the plan's 'porch cover, deck above'), passes the brick chimney (projects 2'10") and the 32" door, reaches the house corner, and a 6' wing continues 30' out along the brick side wall (BR-13, 108" door D-1 onto it, pergola cover over it). The wing's inner wall is HOVER's 8'4" / 9'10" / 8'11" segments with 1' jogs in and out (the plan's diagonals) — framed straight here. Wing outer edge and far end are open (rail). Overall 37' along the back = 26'11" + 4'1" + 6' — the plan's numbers close on the HOVER walls. Heights: ~8' at the window bay (walkout), ~6' at the wing; frame at 8', posts cut to grade. STAIR: 4' wide, 9 risers (66" rise) to a concrete pad, leaves the wing's far end and runs on down along the side wall (siding + basement windows, one rail) — modelled on the wing's outer edge near its end (same quantities; the 3D shows it turned 90 degrees). Engine frames the wing with joists running its length on intermediate beams; a 30' ledger on the brick side wall with 6' joists is the alternative for the engineer. Plan says joists AND boards run perpendicular to the house — GSX frame kept (boards parallel). Existing deck (all of it) is demo'd: stained wood, black aluminum balusters with a flat drink-rail cap, 6x6 posts. Existing translucent-panel cover on 6x6 posts stands on the wing: take down and reset on the new frame (RFI, not priced). PPRBD: 30 psf snow, 30" frost, 115 mph — confirm the lot is not in the special wind region.
